text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system interprets prior interactions as continuing interest in broadly related products or music, with limited distinction between general relevance and a current reason to choose.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend a specific recurring interest, such as an artist, holiday listening, or connected electronics projects.",
    "Complementary items appeal when they support an established task or add a useful capability to existing equipment."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with stronger matches despite lacking evidence of the specific task, sound, or equipment fit that motivates selection.",
    "Recommendations repeat recently satisfied needs or offer overlapping alternatives without establishing additional value.",
    "Older interests remain prominent when recent interactions suggest a narrower current direction."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared product domain, ecosystem, musical era, or collection format appears to substitute for a specific connection to user needs.",
    "A purchase within a product family is treated as evidence of demand for more variants, specialized supplies, or larger quantities."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent interactions and repeated coherent interests provide stronger evidence of current intent than isolated historical choices.",
    "Compatibility, suitable quantity, and incremental usefulness determine whether a related product is actually worth choosing.",
    "Specific artists, musical qualities, and listening context matter more than broad genre or era similarity.",
    "Sparse histories and missing item descriptions limit how confidently relevance can be inferred, especially for movies."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top-ranked items often share a broad association with the history but lack the specific current purpose, fit, or added value needed to motivate a choice.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations selected by users, separated from items judged merely related or potentially useful.",
    "The frequency of rejected top-ranked items attributed to unsupported tasks, compatibility concerns, excessive quantities, or already satisfied needs.",
    "The frequency with which selected items follow recent coherent interests while rejected items follow broad or older associations.",
    "The frequency of indeterminate relevance caused by missing item information, tracked separately from explicit content mismatch."
  ]
}
